conclusions.rootCause: Animation accountPageIn (240ms ease-out) interpolates opacity from 0 to 1. The test runner sampled at t ~100ms when opacity was ~0.70, causing axe-core to compute blended contrast against canvas (#f4f6f9). When settled (opacity=1) or under prefers-reduced-motion, all 4 elements achieve full WCAG AA contrast (>= 4.5:1).
